evidence: Walked every launch assumption in tests/test.sh against the public brief/notes. (1) Entry: test.sh:68 refuses to grade without /app/server.js and launches `node "$APP_ENTRY"` (test.sh:97,111) -> instruction.md:13 'It must start with node /app/server.js'; integration.md:5. (2) Symlink refusal: test.sh:72-83 exits unless every symlink is under /app/node_modules and resolves there -> integration.md:16-19 states exactly this. (3) Unprivileged launch, writable copy, cwd: test.sh:85-111 chowns /app to 65534, falls back to /tmp/submission copy, runs `setsid env -i ... setpriv --reuid=65534` with cwd inherited (/tests, made go-rwx at test.sh:12) -> hireops_rules.md section 8: 'may launch Node from a working directory other than the application directory. It runs as an unprivileged user and may launch a writable copy ... Resolve bundled UI and seed files relative to the entry or module directory'. (4) Env vars: test.sh:105-109 inject only PATH, NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules, HOME, PORT=3000, DB_PATH -> hireops_rules.md section 8 'The launch environment contains PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT and DB_PATH; do not rely on inherited shell variables'; instruction.md:13 'listen on port 3000 (honour PORT if it's set) ... /app/app.db, honouring DB_PATH'; integration.md:3-4 packages 'available through NODE_PATH'. (5) Probe URL: test.sh:48 probes http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health then / -> instruction.md:13 'expose GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database'; integration.md:5-6,9-10 'listens on port 3000 on 0.0.0.0', 'GET /api/health answers before database work can block startup' (so a conforming app becomes live inside the ~30s loop at test.sh:116-122). (6) DB path: APP_DB=/app/app.db or copy/app.db (test.sh:98,101) -> DB_PATH honouring is stated in instruction, integration and rules section 8. (7) Seed: test.sh injects no seed path; instruction.md:15 tells the agent to copy what it needs into /app because /assets is unavailable at runtime, which is stricter than the verifier (task.toml artifacts include /assets; test.sh:88 only chmods it) - lenient, not an unfair hidden requirement. (8) Restart: generated helper (test.sh:127-193) relaunches with the identical env/uid/DB_PATH -> instruction.md:15 'keep new work across restarts', integration.md:8-9. (9) Deps: both images are node:22-bookworm-slim based with express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 globally and NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (environment/Dockerfile:1,3,9-11; tests/Dockerfile:1,4,9,16-21) -> integration.md:3-4 'Node 22 process with Express and better-sqlite3 already available through NODE_PATH; use only those packages and Node built-ins', instruction.md:13 'don't install packages'. (10) Judge URL http://localhost:3000 in app_context.md:4 and every prompt line 1 matches port 3000; no same-origin requirement (network public, per profile). No fixed clock exists in this task and test.sh injects no clock/TZ, so no clock assumption to state. Sign-in: accounts and password are stated in instruction.md:17 anyway, so the check-23 known false positive does not even arise. Counterexample attempts: (a) broken app that could pass the launch: one that reads /assets/seed_data.json at runtime would still launch in the verifier (artifact present), but that is verifier leniency, not an unstated demand; an app returning HTTP 500 on /api/health passes liveness (HTTPError treated as ready, test.sh:51-52) but the render gate grades real behaviour - not a contract mismatch. (b) Conforming app that could fail: an app resolving files via process.cwd() or relying on NODE_ENV/TZ would fail, but rules section 8 forbids both; an app binding 127.0.0.1 or 0.0.0.0 is probed at 127.0.0.1 and works; an app that is slow to seed still answers health first as the notes require. Found none that follows the public contract yet fails launch. P3 note (no defect): the agent image has sqlite3 CLI and git (environment/Dockerfile:6) that the verifier image lacks (tests/Dockerfile:12-14); an app shelling out to them would fail only at grading, but integration.md:3-4 already restricts the app to Express, better-sqlite3 and Node built-ins, so this is bounded latent robustness. Runtime evidence: raw-evidence-index artifacts re-hashed and match; workspace.cjs:16 launched the frozen golden with cwd /tmp and a sanitized env (PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT=3000, DB_PATH) in the verifier image as uid 65534 per index scope, with a passing 'restart keeps jobs, cards, order, messages and activity without reseeding' result and server.log 'listening on 3000' twice. That approximates but is not an execution of tests/test.sh itself; no full configured verifier launch/grading record exists (index scope states full configured grading is absent). risk=true solely for that missing required runtime evidence; the source-level contract agreement shows no defect.
